name: Extraction of Surface Points (Sobierajski)
definition: A fast display method for direct rendering of boundary surfaces by extracting only visible boundary voxels from volume data.
summary: Extraction of Surface Points (Sobierajski) is a fast direct rendering method that extracts visible boundary voxels using orthographic visibility tests and 2D boundary tracing, differing from mesh-based approaches by operating on individual voxel boundaries.
